webToken.title: Advanced: Monthly total
webToken.hint: Shows your Kimi web monthly total usage (Kimi + Code). Paste the refresh_token once and the app keeps it renewed automatically — no more periodic re-pasting. The refresh_token stays valid for up to ~90 days, after which you need to paste a new one (legacy kimi-auth values still work).
webToken.step1post: in your browser and sign in
webToken.step2: Press F12 to open DevTools → Application → Local Storage → https://www.kimi.com
webToken.step3: Copy the value of refresh_token and paste it below (if it is an array, join its parts with dots)
webToken.saved: Verified and saved: total usage {{total}}% (Kimi {{kimi}}% · Code {{code}}%)
